title: Managing Member Reviews and Rating Moderation

sections.heading: Review Moderation Settings
sections.content:
To manage and moderate client reviews submitted to member profiles:
1. Go to My Members > Member Reviews.
2. Pending reviews are listed with star ratings, reviewer comments, and member profile link.
3. Admins can click 'Approve', 'Decline', or 'Edit'.
4. In General Settings > Member Settings, you can enable 'Auto-Approve Reviews' or require manual admin approval before reviews become publicly visible.

procedural_steps: Inspect incoming reviews with star ratings and comments
Click Approve to publish or Decline to discard
Configure Auto-Approve policy in Member Settings
full_text:
Review Moderation Settings
To manage and moderate client reviews submitted to member profiles:
1. Go to My Members > Member Reviews.
2. Pending reviews are listed with star ratings, reviewer comments, and member profile link.
3. Admins can click 'Approve', 'Decline', or 'Edit'.
4. In General Settings > Member Settings, you can enable 'Auto-Approve Reviews' or require manual admin approval before reviews become publicly visible.
